DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia

The presence of blasts with Auer rods on your blood smear is pathognomonic for Acute Myeloid Leukemia. The combination of severe anemia, thrombocytopenia causing bruising, and a massive white blood cell count confirms this aggressive malignancy. We will need to proceed immediately with bone marrow aspiration to confirm the cell lineage and begin treatment.
